programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same "street" family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: Son of Dragon is a two-part mini series that retells the Arabian Night's story of "The Thief of Bagdad" setting it in ancient China. The story follows a young man, Devil Boy, who was abandoned at birth. He grows up to become a thief to provide for street children he considers family. Together with his faithful friend and teacher, Bird, he has a plan to rob the royal court of Shanghai. But there he falls in love with the daughter of the Governor, Princess Li Wei. To win over her hand he has to compete against other potential suitors in various challenges set by by the Governor.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Tel Avivo „Maccabi“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor

Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Predator Fail: When Prey Attacks
programme.desc: Animals such as the lion, the crocodile, and the shark are rightly considered to be among the most deadly predators on the planet, expert hunting and killing machines. However, their natural instincts, experience and physical abilities are still no guarantee for success. And who doesn't enjoy the thrill of an underdog prey being able to outsmart or outmanouver one of these formidable killers? This series exmaines what happens when these top carnivores get it wrong, proving that they can make mistakes just like the rest of us. From a lion making four jumps to tackle a gazelle to a black mamba's aim being slightly awry!

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: Australias coastline is a true natural wonder, encompassing a diverse range of bountiful habitats. Coastal seas and lands are realms of epic migrations, mesmerising mating rituals and high stakes battles between predator and prey.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Tree Kangaroos: Ghosts of the Forest
programme.desc: Seldom seen and very rarely filmed in their natural environment, Lumholtz tree kangaroos are the ghosts of the north Queensland forests. This film follows the intimate lives of these tree-climbing specialists in the wilderness of the Atherton Tableland.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Nati stanchi
programme.desc: Prima commedia da protagonisti per Ficarra e Picone. Due giovani siciliani disoccupati e svogliati partecipano ai concorsi e si presentano ai colloqui facendo in modo di non essere assunti.

programme.title: CHiPS
programme.desc: Dax Shepard, Michael Pena e un cameo di Erik Estrada nella commedia ispirata alla serie tv anni 80. Per indagare su un giro di corruzione, un agente Fbi lavorerà con una recluta.

programme.title: The Parenting
programme.desc: Brian Cox e Lisa Kudrow in una commedia a tinte horror. Una coppia organizza un weekend per presentare i genitori, ma la casa in affitto è infestata da un poltergeist.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Quattro pellicole natalizie, che hanno riscosso il successo di pubblico, disponibili su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Yes Man
programme.desc: Jim Carrey sfoggia la sua comicità in una graffiante commedia. Insoddisfatto della sua vita, un uomo abbraccia una nuova filosofia che segue una semplice ma pericolosa regola.

programme.title: Gli anni belli
programme.desc: Maria Grazia Cucinotta e Ninni Bruschetta in una commedia ambientata negli anni 90. Costretta a passare le vacanze nel solito campeggio, la ribelle Elena vivra' un'estate indimenticabile.

programme.title: La stanza degli omicidi
programme.desc: Due criminali organizzano un sistema di riciclaggio di denaro sporco con una gallerista d'arte di New York. Il sistema sembra funzionare a gonfie vele, finche' un imprevisto non complica la faccenda.

programme.title: Ma cosa ci dice il cervello
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Paola Cortellesi e un super cast nella commedia campione d'incassi. Giovanna mette le sue abilita' di agente segreto al servizio degli amici per vendicarli.

programme.title: Lasciati andare
programme.desc: Francesco Amato dirige Toni Servillo in una commedia sul corpo e la mente. Un disincantato psicanalista, costretto a mettersi a dieta, si affida a una svampita personal trainer.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Mai Stati Uniti
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Vincenzo Salemme e Ambra Angiolini. Cinque persone scoprono di essere figlie dello stesso padre. Per ricevere l'eredita', devono spargerne le ceneri in Arizona.

programme.title: Come ammazzare il capo... e vivere felici
programme.desc: Jason Bateman, Jennifer Aniston e Kevin Spacey in una scatenata black comedy. Stanchi delle angherie dei rispettivi superiori, tre amici elaborano un piano per farli fuori.

programme.title: Come ammazzare il capo 2
programme.desc: Sequel di "Come ammazzare il capo... e vivere felici" con un cast di star hollywoodiane. Nick, Dale e Kurt decidono di mettersi in proprio, ma dovranno vedersela con un cinico investitore.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: Omicidio a Los Angeles
programme.desc: Eccentrica commedia Sky Original con Mel Gibson e Charlie Hunnam. Un ex poliziotto lascia la sua casa nel bosco per indagare su un delitto di cui è stato accusato un divo della tv.

programme.desc: La fantasia incontenibile di Tim Burton per l'atteso sequel con Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega e Monica Bellucci. Per salvare la figlia dal regno dei morti, Lydia stringe un patto con il dispettoso Beetlejuice, che a sua volta deve liberarsi dell'ex moglie Delores.

programme.desc: Divertente commedia con Samuel L. Jackson e Eugene Levy. Quando il destino di un agente federale poco ortodosso incrocia quello di un ignaro rappresentante, l'improbabile diventa plausibile.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchissimi

programme.desc: La comicità politicamente scorretta di Angelo Duro in una commedia scritta insieme al regista Gennaro Nunziante. Angelo lascia Roma per tornare a Palermo per prendersi cura dei genitori anziani, ma con l'intenzione di vendicarsi di tutti i torti subiti durante l'infanzia.

They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. programme.title: CSI S4 E10 - Coming of Rage
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: 3:10 To Yuma
programme.desc: Dan menawarkan diri untuk mengantar pemimpin geng perampok, Ben Wade, ke stasiun kereta guna dibawa ke pengadilan. Namun, anggota geng Ben yang terdiri dari pembunuh dan perampok memiliki rencana lain.

programme.title: The 6th Day
programme.desc: Di masa depan saat kloning menjadi lumrah, sebuah perusahaan mengkloning manusia secara ilegal. Namun, suatu kesalahan kloning fatal membuat seorang pria harus menghindari upaya pembunuhan dan merebut kembali hidupnya.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Di Inggris pada abad ke-12, Robin dan kelompok perampoknya menghadapi korupsi di desa setempat dan memimpin pemberontakan melawan penguasa yang nantinya akan mengubah keseimbangan kekuasaan di dunia.

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Diangkat berdasarkan serial drama/aksi tahun 1980-an, film ini berfokus pada dua detektif bernama Crockett dan Tubbs saat karier dan kehidupan pribadi mereka saling terkait secara berbahaya.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Kehidupan seorang wanita yang sedang berlibur berubah drastis ketika ia bertemu dengan pria impiannya. Dia tidak mengetahui jika ternyata pria itu adalah pembunuh bayaran yang bekerja pada pemerintah.

programme.title: Welcome To Sudden Death

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
